question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you like Paige and Owen?

labels: Use an air current to slow Paige down!

nodes.text: Owen turns to his shopping basket and is surprised to find it filled to the brim with strawberries, chocolate, and croissants.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Strawberries? Chocolate? Fancy bread things?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I must have grabbed these without thinking about it... These look pretty good for a picnic...
He looks around and spots Paige at the end of the aisle, looking at the drinks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Glad to see she's actually helping me out.
Paige selects some sparkling apple juice and walks back to Owen. She skims through the basket and nods thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not bad, not bad...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Nice choices, Hamlet!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I couldn't have done it without you.
Sowphelia feels herself turn pinker than usual!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe this date won't be so bad after all...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So it `is` a date.
nodes.text_bbcode: So it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a date.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's an 'outing.' Are we picnicking or not?
They check out and walk outside.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Did you hear that?! They're going on a picnic!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, let's go after them.
Owen turns to his shopping basket and finds it filled with groceries.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anchovies? Bratwurst?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why would I `pick` these?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why would I [color=#e23b3b][i]pick[/i][/color] these?

nodes.text: Owen starts to put everything back, but Paige walks up to him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Find anything good?
She skims through the basket.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anchovies? Gross! And canned chili? How do you think we'll open it without a can opener, brainless?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was `trying.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#e23b3b][i]trying.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Clearly, we're going to have to do things my way.
She plucks a baguette and two fancy water bottles off the shelf, and they check out.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Ouch. Bread and water isn't going to set the mood.
Sowphelia and Hamlet sadly follow.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think you really know what that word means.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, loser.
They walk into a shopping complex, passing by cute boutiques and nice restaurants.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This French restaurant over here is a hole-in-the-wall, but it's delicious...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is a 'hole-in-the-wall' for you? If you pay money for fried snails, then there's a word for people like you... 'Sucker.'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Because eating hot dogs makes you less of a chump.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, hot dogs are exactly what we can afford.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nuh-uh. No way. I'm not taking a step anywhere near a fast food place.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That doesn't give us a lot of options...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Being 'poor' is so exhausting. There must be `something...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Being 'poor' is so exhausting. There must be [color=#3b78e2][i]something...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, I think I saw a grocery down the block...
Owen and Paige step into the grocery.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So what do you want to get?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is your 'outing'. You pick. I'm going to go look over here...
Paige wanders off towards the more expensive food items as Owen starts putting things in a basket.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, this canned chili is only a couple bucks!
Behind Owen, Sowphelia snorts at Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to help him!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Help him do what? He's finally with Paige. All we have to do is sit back.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: No! We can't let him pick those foods!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Why are you interfering? They're together.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The Hogfather didn't want them to be together... He wanted them to be `together!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The Hogfather didn't want them to be together... He wanted them to be [color=#3b78e2][i]together![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What is the difference exactly?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: If you want to make sparks fly and hearts sing... You have to set the mood! And you're not going to do that with something like chili from a can!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: All right... Point taken. But I don't `know` what a romantic food is supposed to look like...
nodes.text_bbcode: All right... Point taken. But I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] what a romantic food is supposed to look like...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: That's because all you eat is slop.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Romantic foods are easy to eat, sweet, and French!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: If you say so...
Hamlet flies low and knocks Owen's basket out of his hand. The basket's contents tumble to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aw, man...
Owen bends to pick them up, and Sowphelia and Hamlet start bringing things back to the basket...
Sowphelia flutters her wings, causing a poster for the movie 'Valentine's Kiss' to flap enticingly in the wind. The motion draws Owen's attention. He grins.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's see a movie.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If it's not live, what's the point?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on, even you can't pretend you've never been in a movie theater before. I'll lead the way.
He offers her his arm, and she takes it. He buys the tickets, and they walk in.
Sowphelia and Hamlet follow. The theater is packed with couples going to see a romantic movie on Valentine's Day.
Paige and Owen are jostled around, but manage to find seats. Sowphelia and Hamlet dodge people before alighting on a rail above Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I hope it's good...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's romantic. It's perfect.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't see the appeal of public movie theaters.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, hob-knob with us commoners every once in a while. It's probably good for you. Now be quiet, the movie's starting.
A couple hours later...
Paige and Owen walk out arguing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know how you can put up with such drivel.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It was kind of sweet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was kind of `lame.` The main girl found her guy, and suddenly she's going to be together with him forever? Let me tell you that it's a load of crap.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was kind of [color=#3b78e2][i]lame.[/i][/color] The main girl found her guy, and suddenly she's going to be together with him forever? Let me tell you that it's a load of crap.

nodes.text: Sowphelia shoots Hamlet a worried look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one stays together `forever.` At best, you're with someone for a long time, but everyone leaves you eventually.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one stays together [color=#3b78e2][i]forever.[/i][/color] At best, you're with someone for a long time, but everyone leaves you eventually.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow, that's depressing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, welcome to my life. At least, unlike some other losers, I have a big pile of money to roll around in.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow, just rub that right in.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. There was so much sap in that movie, it made me hungry. I'm `starving.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. There was so much sap in that movie, it made me hungry. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]starving.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sowphelia flutters her wings, causing the 'OPEN' sign for the arcade to flap enticingly in the wind. The motion draws Owen's attention. He grins.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's go to the arcade.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew, why would we willingly go to a place that smells like green soda and cheese puffs?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because it's fun. And more importantly, it's cheap.
Owen and Paige walk into the arcade. Sowphelia and Hamlet fly in behind them, settling on top of the arcade cabinets.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... What does one do here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You can't tell me you've never been in an arcade.
Paige glares at him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't like to touch coins... Or machines... Or anything `nerds` have touched.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't like to touch coins... Or machines... Or anything [color=#3b78e2][i]nerds[/i][/color] have touched.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That is so sad. It's like you've never really lived.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Says the guy who's never been to Paris.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whatever. They have croissants, we have croissants.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why do I even go out with you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't. This is just an 'outing'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey over there! It's Knight Knockout. I used to play this all the time when I was a kid...
Owen exchanges some money for game tokens and leads Paige over to an arcade machine with fierce-looking knights on the cabinet.
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly around them nervously.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Maybe this was a bad idea... They fight a lot.
They start playing and thirty minutes later...
Paige pumps her arms up in the air as her character delivers a devastating last blow to Owen's!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! Yes! `Yes!` Take that halberd in your castle! I win again! I `love` winning!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! Yes! [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes![/i][/color] Take that halberd in your castle! I win again! I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] winning!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know... And so does every other six-year-old in this place...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Again?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... We're out of tokens... And unless you want to use up the rest of my money, we'd better stop.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was just getting fun!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean... This place isn't as terrible as I expected.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh-huh.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Yes! That went so well!
Sowphelia touches her wing to Hamlet's. He turns pink.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Yes... Good call.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Maybe we do have a chance after all...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So where to next?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All that playing made me work up an appetite. I'm `starving.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All that playing made me work up an appetite. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]starving.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: They get into Owen's car and head for the city.
Sowphelia and Hamlet follow Paige and Owen down the street.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... Where to?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I figured we'd just wander around.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You didn't have anything planned?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's not like we're on a cruise. What, is every single hour of your day planned out?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, `no`, but everything fun is going to be booked. I mean, it `is` Valentine's Day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color], but everything fun is going to be booked. I mean, it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Yes.` You are so clueless.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes.[/i][/color] You are so clueless.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I knew what day it was!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I'm taking control of this day, and we're going to do something fun. Have you ever sailed on a yacht before?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who hasn't sailed on a yacht?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that's right... `Everyone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, that's right... [color=#e23b3b][i]Everyone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm going to stop asking rhetorical questions. We're going to the wharf.
Sowphelia and Hamlet follow them.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You think this is a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What's more romantic than a boat ride?
Paige drags Owen down to the pier to rent a yacht.

nodes.speaker: Attendant
nodes.text: That'll be five hundred dollars.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa, are you sure?
Paige puts her credit card down on the counter and winks at Owen.
The attendant slides her card and frowns.

nodes.speaker: Attendant
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but your card has been declined.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Slide it better!
The attendant tries again, but it comes up negative. Paige hands him another card, but that one is declined as well.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Try again.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Try again.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right, high horse. It's not working. Let's not scare the nice man away with your mean face.
Owen puts both hands on her shoulders and steers Paige away from the booth.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This has never happened before! None of my credit cards work! What are we supposed to do now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not go on a five hundred dollar date would be my first guess.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't you dare smile when you say--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Wait, so this is a date?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, no! We're just... On an 'outing'. On Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So if my credit cards don't work... Where are we going to go on this 'outing'?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Somewhere low class. Dangerous. Dirty.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're talking about your room, I pass.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Very funny, but that's not what I'm talking about.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It isn't? 'Cause whatever you're talking about sounds super gross.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's just how the little people live when they have...
He checks his wallet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thirty dollars.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That can't even buy me a hat. What are we going to do with thirty dollars?
Owen and Sowphelia glance up and down the wharf and spot a movie theater and an arcade.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, there's a showing of 'Valentine's Kiss' in fifteen minutes. Or we could use some of these dollars at the arcade. If you can stomach losing to a guy.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Which is better?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We want them to be close... So the best choice is the...
Sowphelia flaps her wings, and an air current slows Paige down for just a fraction of a second...
Long enough for Owen to catch her!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: That was close. I'm glad she didn't hurt herself...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Climb down the trellis', he says. 'It'll be fun', he says.
Owen grins.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're fine now, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, now put me down. We have to get out of here in case someone heard that!
Sowphelia tries to use her magic and grasps Paige's shoe! Paige slows in her fall, but her shoe slips off!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
Hamlet flaps his wings, creating a huge gust of air under Paige! Owen rushes up to Paige just as she hits the ground.
He helps her up, and she dusts herself off.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Thanks, Hamlet! Good catch!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Yeah, it wouldn't have been good if she'd actually hurt herself...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Climb down the trellis', he says. 'It'll be fun', he says.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're okay now, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, no thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Must have been that big ego that broke your fall...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's just get out of here in case someone heard all that noise!
Sowphelia hesitates!
Sowphelia taps her hoof against the window. Paige sets down her brush and walks over to investigate the noise.
She lets herself out onto her small balcony. From there, Paige sees Owen walking away.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh... Paige. I was just--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's just like you to throw rocks at my window like a common peasant.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I didn't throw anything. You're the one who called me.
Paige glances at her phone and sees his number at the top of her call list.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Must have pocket dialed. What do you want, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was trying to visit you, but Tad turned me away.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm grounded.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So what? That means you can't answer your own door?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It means I was ordered not to leave my room.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you shouldn't `try.` Come with me. You said we should hang out before you had to leave.
nodes.text_bbcode: But that doesn't mean you shouldn't [color=#e23b3b][i]try.[/i][/color] Come with me. You said we should hang out before you had to leave.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't that what `you` said?
nodes.text_bbcode: Isn't that what [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] said?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's all a blur. But come on, let's get out of here. Be 'grounded' down here... On the ground.
Excitedly, Sowphelia snerts.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is working out better than I ever thought it could!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I `can't.` It's against the rules.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]can't.[/i][/color] It's against the rules.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah, like you've never broken a rule in your life.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How am I going to get down, genius? My mother and Tad are still downstairs somewhere. And they're not leaving for their, ugh, `date` for another couple hours.
nodes.text_bbcode: How am I going to get down, genius? My mother and Tad are still downstairs somewhere. And they're not leaving for their, ugh, [color=#3b78e2][i]date[/i][/color] for another couple hours.

nodes.text: Owen eyes the sturdy trellis winding up to Paige's room.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about the trellis?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Hamlet, this is so romantic!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It'll be tragic if she falls. He can't be serious.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can't be serious.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's the point of having a trellis if you don't use it to escape? Climb down. It'll be fun!
Paige takes one look at her door then at the trellis. She swings a leg over her window ledge and grabs hold of trellis.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, but if I break my leg... I'm blaming you!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Be on alert, Sowphelia...
Slowly, Paige makes her way down the wall...
With one story left to go, one of the wooden slats on the trellis breaks! Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige!
Owen runs forward to catch her...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: He won't make it!

options.label: Use an air current to slow Paige down!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The second floor, first window!
They fly up to it and find a room filled entirely with trampolines!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's a bouncing room! This is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Don't even think about it, Hamlet...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Not even one bounce?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: `Come on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Come on![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The second floor, fifth window!
They fly up to it and find Tad and Margot speaking.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I know you'll miss your daughter when you send her off to Monarch Prep, but there are certain advantages to having the mansion all to ourselves...
Tad pulls Margot into a tight embrace as he kisses her dispassionately on the lips.
The cupigs pinwheel away from the window with horror.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Ew! Gross! Rich people making out!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I didn't even know kisses could be so cold and materialistic!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We got the wrong floor!
Hamlet and Sowphelia fly frantically around, checking each window... But Paige is nowhere to be found.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: This house is too big! We'll never find it now...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: You can't give up yet! I'm checking one more window...
Sowphelia peeks into one last window and spots Paige brushing her hair at her vanity table.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is the room! I see Paige!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Yes! Finally! But we gotta do something fast, Owen looks like he's about to leave!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The first window!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Which window?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: It's the third floor! I'm sure of it...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Which window?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The second floor?
The next day...
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly to the window outside Paige's room. They can hear Paige and her mother arguing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was a `party,` not a `gala.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was a [color=#3b78e2][i]party,[/i][/color] not a [color=#3b78e2][i]gala.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: A party that would have ruined `my` home.
nodes.text_bbcode: A party that would have ruined [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] home.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: There were `hoodlums` jumping like cannon balls into the pool, and there were `strings of paper` hanging from my chandelier!
nodes.text_bbcode: There were [color=#3b78e2][i]hoodlums[/i][/color] jumping like cannon balls into the pool, and there were [color=#3b78e2][i]strings of paper[/i][/color] hanging from my chandelier!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's called `crepe paper`, and it's a `decoration.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's called [color=#3b78e2][i]crepe paper[/i][/color], and it's a [color=#3b78e2][i]decoration.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: That's even more atrocious than I'd previously imagined.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I bet Dad wouldn't have minded. He'd have thought it was funny.
Margot glares at her daughter and shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Don't talk about him. You have a new father in your life.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And until further notice, you're `grounded.` You are forbidden to leave the grounds.
nodes.text_bbcode: And until further notice, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]grounded.[/i][/color] You are forbidden to leave the grounds.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's what 'grounded' means, doesn't it?
As soon as Margot shuts the door firmly behind her, Paige flops angrily down onto her bed.
Outside Paige's window, Sowphelia gives Hamlet a worried look.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: If Paige is stuck at home, how are we ever going to get them together?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We'll think of something. Let's go find Owen. Can you track him?
Sowphelia sniffs the air, her snout twitching.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We don't have to! He's here!
Still invisible, they fly down from the `fifth window` on the `third floor` and find Owen at the front door. He's talking to Tad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Still invisible, they fly down from the [b]fifth window[/b] on the [b]third floor[/b] and find Owen at the front door. He's talking to Tad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Young ruffian, Paige is currently 'grounded' and unable to see visitors at this time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right... Is there a better time when I can come back?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Certainly not for `you.` Paige is a very important young lady. You are not of suitable rank to her social standing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Certainly not for [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] Paige is a very important young lady. You are not of suitable rank to her social standing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's up for Paige to decide. Now if you'd just move aside--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It would be most inappropriate for me to let you in. Now good day! And do not call again.
The door shuts in Owen's face before Owen can so much as get another word out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Not of suitable rank'? Well, it's going to take a lot more than that to keep me from seeing her...
Owen glances at the formidable doors in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I guess it'll just have to be next week at school...
He starts walking away from the manor. Sowphelia and Hamlet exchange glances.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Any ideas? Too bad we can't push one of these topiaries onto his head. Or talk to him directly.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: You know we can't reveal ourselves!
Sowphelia notices Owen's cell phone peeking out of his back pocket.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But we can send him a message...
Sowphelia flutters her wings, and a silver halo surrounds the phone. It begins to ring. Owen picks it up and glances at the caller.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige?
He answers, but there's no one on the other line.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe she's sending me a message...
He walks back towards the manor, ducking behind the house to find Paige's room. He looks up and sees four floors with five windows on each level.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't tell which room's hers... She just has to live in a house with twenty windows, doesn't she?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to show him which one's Paige's room.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Where is it again?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Her room is on...
Sowphelia has failed.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Close the doors! Quick!
The open door Owen is walking towards suddenly blows shut. He pauses, uncertain.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Come on... Turn around, turn around...
Owen angrily grabs the door handle, twists, and flings it open. He walks out into the night, intending never to return.
Hamlet flies up to a bookcase near Paige where a small statue is resting.
He flutters his wings and pushes the statue over! It rolls onto Paige's foot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: OW!
Paige stumbles back against the wall.
Owen whirls around and goes to her.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Bingo!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you okay?
Owen runs back to help her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm `fine.` Something just fell on my foot.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]fine.[/i][/color] Something just fell on my foot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look. I didn't bring it up because news like that sucks. I didn't want people treating me differently or anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And honestly, I knew my leaving would be a real blow to you, and I didn't want you to be even more upset than you are now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh-huh. You're always looking out for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't like your tone.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... When do you leave?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why do you care?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't. I just thought we should hang out before you go.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Otherwise, you'll be all sad without me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: As if. When would we even hang out?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What about tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding? After getting in trouble for this party? I'm pretty sure my mom's going to lock me up forever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, we'll figure something out.
He walks out of the house.
Outside, Sowphelia and Hamlet breathe a sigh of relief.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I'm glad we stopped him. There was no way they were going to get together by tomorrow if we'd let him leave.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It was a close one all right.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But what are we going to do now? It's not a sure thing like you were saying, Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I know you don't like $ZOE and Owen together, but if we don't get our game together, we're bacon toast!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We'll get them to kiss tomorrow, Sowphelia.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I hope so...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh... Er...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: A little faster, Sowphelia!
He flies in a small circle nervously.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: $ZOE cares for him, and she helped him deal with his past.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Well, that `was` very sweet, but Owen doesn't need someone who's the same as he is.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] very sweet, but Owen doesn't need someone who's the same as he is.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: And even if $ZOE and Owen have some chemistry, it doesn't matter. The Hogfather said we need to turn the heat up on Owen and Paige.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Which means getting them to `kiss` and admit that they care about one another.
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means getting them to [color=#3b78e2][i]kiss[/i][/color] and admit that they care about one another.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: And like I said, don't be such a worry warthog. Everything's going to be--
At that moment, a loud squeal from a panicked pig can be heard on the loudspeakers throughout the Pig Pen.
`SNERT!` `SNERT!` `SNERT!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SNERT![/b] [b]SNERT![/b] [b]SNERT![/b]

nodes.text: A voice that seems to come from above cuts through the crowd of cupigs like a thunderclap.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Snert Alert! Snert Alert! The Owen-Paige case has reached critical. Cupigs, report! Cupigs, report!
Sowphelia and Hamlet push away from the trough they're enjoying.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: That's a week's worth of truffles you owe me!
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly down, shooting through the blanket of stars and clouds to earth below.
From the air, they can see the bright lights of a party at Paige's manor.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What could have gone wrong?! They were enjoying the party when we left!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Things change quickly. Come on, let's get into stealth mode before one of these young humans see us.
Sowphelia concentrates and flutters her wings. A shimmery halo rings her tiny body, then fades away.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Done. Let's fly in for a closer look.
Hamlet turns himself invisible and follows her.
The cupigs find their way inside...
Where Paige's mother Margot and soon-to-be stepfather Tad are standing in the foyer, yelling at Paige!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Never mind `that!` What is this, Paige?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color] What is this, Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not supposed to be back for another week!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `Surprise.` Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Surprise.[/i][/color] Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are my friends, mom.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Ha! Now I know you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: This is exactly what I've been telling you about, Margot. The rebelliousness comes from her peers.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You're right. So right. This abomination here is the reason, Paige, why we decided you will no longer be attending that public school!
The partygoers gasp!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It's why you'll be going `back` to Monarch Prep!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's why you'll be going [color=#3b78e2][i]back[/i][/color] to Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Now everyone else, get out of my house this instant, or I shall call the authorities!
Margot and Tad start marshaling everyone out of the house as Owen turns to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why didn't you tell me your mother was sending you back to Monarch?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why would I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... Maybe because we're friends? You didn't think this was something you could warn me about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe I didn't see why it would really `matter.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I didn't see why it would really [color=#3b78e2][i]matter.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I see...
Owen turns away from her and starts walking away.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm leaving. Your mom is kicking everyone out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I don't see why that would `matter` to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't see why that would [color=#e23b3b][i]matter[/i][/color] to you.

nodes.text: As Owen walks away, Sowphelia hisses to Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: He's leaving! And they're never going to kiss tomorrow if we don't do something!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What do you suggest I do? Tackle him?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: That's not a `bad` idea...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not a [color=#3b78e2][i]bad[/i][/color] idea...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You know we can't touch them directly. We can only move things around them...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you going to quote the entire Cupig's Hoofbook to me? Do something!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Do you have any suggestions?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What about using a Cupig's Arrow? We could make Owen change his mind!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We only have one each... We can't use them every time we run into a problem.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Good point. Okay, uh...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: So perfect for one another that they're constantly fighting all the time?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Well, sometimes couples disagree...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: So perfect that she's always putting him down and making fun of his Grandma Betty.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: It's very affectionate!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Face it, Sowphelia. You don't have a better argument than `mine`, which is that $ZOE and Owen are very good to each other.
nodes.text_bbcode: Face it, Sowphelia. You don't have a better argument than [color=#e23b3b][i]mine[/i][/color], which is that $ZOE and Owen are very good to each other.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Everyone knows that couples that are different stay together longer.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Why do you think so many love stories are about people who are complete opposites getting together?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Well, there is some truth to that...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: It keeps the magic alive.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: But I still think $ZOE and Owen are good together.

nodes.text: The arrow hits the tire! It blows out, and Hamlet and Sowphelia watch the car move safely to the side of the road.
An irate Margot and Tad get out of the car to inspect their tire.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What the devil?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: This is `such` an inconvenience!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]such[/i][/color] an inconvenience!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Let them stew over `that` one for a while!
nodes.text_bbcode: Let them stew over [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] one for a while!

nodes.text: Gleefully, Sowphelia and Hamlet take to the skies, tracking down Owen and Paige...
In Paige's backyard...
Owen and Paige stand next to the trellis outside Paige's window.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So what did you think of this 'outing'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean, this incredibly cheap date?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was `awful.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#3b78e2][i]awful.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It can't have been `that` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: It can't have been [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grocery store food? The wharf? A picnic in the dirt in a park?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know, Owen, I thought we really had something... And because you're not gross to look at, I really wanted to give us a chance.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But the way this date went...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It just proved that I'm in a better and higher class than you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You can't know that off of `one` date!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't know that off of [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] date!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's technically an `outing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's technically an [color=#3b78e2][i]outing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll see you later!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh wait, I won't!
She pats Owen's head and climbs the trellis back into her room...
On the ground, Sowphelia, Hamlet, and Owen stare up at her, regret and a deep sadness in their hearts...
Ouch! That was a terrible ending!
Try again and see if you can help Sowphelia make things right between Paige and Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I didn't hate it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Which means you liked it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I didn't say that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I am saying... Thanks for breaking me out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, I know I'm going to Monarch Prep, but... We should... Stay in touch.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's like a terrible yearbook line. We can't end like that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And how were you planning on ending things?
She looks up at him, and he looks down at her. For an instant, they seem about to move in closer...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: `YES!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]YES![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And that's when Paige's mother arrives to intercept them!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What `are` you doing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: How did she get here?! She wasn't supposed to be home for another twenty minutes!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I think they called a cab instead of waiting around to fix their car...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Oh `no`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: The cupigs watch helplessly as Margot's arrival causes Owen to jump away from Paige.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You! Boy! Get off my property! You don't belong here!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige, if you ever interact with this boy again, you're going to be grounded for the rest of your life!
Margot starts herding Paige back into the manor. Owen tries to go after her, but Tad steps in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You heard the lady of the house. You're not welcome back here, I dare say.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Move aside! I can explain everything... This entire thing is `my` fault...
nodes.text_bbcode: Move aside! I can explain everything... This entire thing is [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] fault...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Doubtlessly. Servants! Come take this boy off the property!
Two big men dressed in servants' uniforms come and take Owen's arms.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey! `Hey!` I can `walk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! [color=#e23b3b][i]Hey![/i][/color] I can [color=#e23b3b][i]walk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He jerks out of their grasp and straightens his shirt. He looks past the servants and Tad to meet Paige's eye.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We'll talk! I promise!
He heads down the driveway, angry and disheartened. Sowphelia and Hamlet give each other a hopeless look.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We were `so` close... Hamlet, `so` close...
nodes.text_bbcode: We were [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] close... Hamlet, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] close...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: And now it seems our bacon is fried... The Hogfather will be most displeased with us!
They start to ascend morosely when...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Wait!
Paige twists out of her mother's hold and glares at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can ground me, you can cancel my credit cards, you can send me away to Monarch Prep, but you can't take today away from me. Especially not after this!
Paige ducks under Ted's hand and runs after Owen.
She grabs his hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, so you're a jerk with a two-dollar hair cut and a terrible fashion sense...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? You ran after me to tell me that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why else would I do it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For this.
He pulls her into a tender kiss that lasts only about as long as it takes for Tad to catch up with them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Catch you later!
He runs off, and Paige smiles wickedly as she follows her parents into the house.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Did you... Did you see that? It worked! We did it!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We did? But they're separated... Maybe for a very long time!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: They may not be together, but they're `together!` Did you see that marvelous, joyous, passionate kiss?
nodes.text_bbcode: They may not be together, but they're [color=#3b78e2][i]together![/i][/color] Did you see that marvelous, joyous, passionate kiss?

nodes.text: And caught up in the wonder and happiness of the moment, she nuzzles her nose against Hamlet's!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Uh... Er...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Snert!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Come on! Let's get back to hog heaven!
They fly together, creating hearts in the clouds and snerting with joy!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is the best Valentine's Day ever!
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 5: Paige and Owen's Valentine's Outing!`

Sowphelia flails around, falling behind! The car races forward, becoming a black dot on the horizon!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: There's no hope now... Margot'll find out Paige isn't home. She'll get in trouble. And she and Owen will never be together...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You don't know that... There's still `some` time.

nodes.text: No, that's not right...
She tries to correct, but instead, flubs the shot! The arrow embeds itself in the green grass next to the road.
Pink flowers burst into life where the arrow hits, blooming rapidly then bursting into a flurry of pink petals before vanishing.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: No! The last arrow!
She looks mournfully from her bow to the car speeding off into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: There's no hope now... Margot'll find out Paige isn't home. She'll get in trouble. And she and Owen will never be together...

nodes.text: Sowphelia panics, and her mind goes blank!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Shoot the arrow now!
She looses the arrow! It hits the grass!
Sowphelia and Hamlet gain on the car, its bumper just within hoof's reach...
Hamlet flutters his wings to send a huge blast of air at the tires, hoping to take the car out...
But the car is too durable! It doesn't even veer off course!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Can you move it?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's too big! Use the other arrow! Take out its tire!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But it's our last one!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Do we really have any other choice?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Oink... I guess not...
Sowphelia nods, takes out her bow and arrow, and aims for...
Sowphelia pumps her wings faster and gains on the car!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: So close... I just need a little more...
Sowphelia flaps her wings, bringing her closer to the car! She sees Hamlet follow suit...
Owen and Paige pull away from the market area with Sowphelia and Hamlet hovering invisibly behind them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where to?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We should probably head back. My mom and Tad went out for dinner, but they're probably going to get home soon.
The cupigs fly high above the couple, and that's when Sowphelia notices Tad and Margot in a car on a road parallel to Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Paige's parents! They're on their way home now too!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is the last chance for Owen and Paige to kiss and get together! We have to deal with them!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: On it!
Sowphelia and Hamlet veer away from Paige to fly after Margot and Tad's car.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We have to make it break down somehow! But it's going too fast!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to go faster!
Sowphelia grits her pig teeth and...
The arrow strikes the florist!
The florist is suddenly filled with the radiance of love. She looks over at a quiet, brown-haired clerk who works at the cheese counter opposite from hers.
She clasps her hands to her heart and flutters her eyelashes. She's still staring at him when Owen walks up to her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, hi. I was wondering about those roses in front...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Oh, those roses are perfect, aren't they? Just like `him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, those roses are perfect, aren't they? Just like [color=#3b78e2][i]him.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She looks dreamily above Owen's shoulder. Owen turns to see what she's looking at and spots the cheese clerk.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sure, I guess. I don't know him...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: I do. We have the same lunch break, and sometimes we talk. But it's never anything more than that.
She sighs.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Young man, do you know what love is?

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Oh, how silly of me. Of course you do. You're with that girl...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're not `really` anything more than just fr--
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] anything more than just fr--

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: It's okay. You don't have to tell me. I know. I'm in love myself.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: You know, I've been watching him the past four years I've worked here. And never once have I told him just how much he means to me.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: He's going away soon. Setting up shop somewhere else. I may never see him again...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: And even now, I can't gather up the courage to say something. I don't have the nerve.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My grandmother says that it's better to be scared and brave than confident and cowardly.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: You're right... Of course you're right. I owe it to both him and me to let him know how I feel. Especially now that he's leaving.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: You remember that now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Er, right...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: I'm going to close up shop and go over right now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So about those flowers...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Just take them. Give them to the one you love.
Owen takes the bouquet as he and Paige are hurried out of the store.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's her hurry?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's in love.
Owen hands Paige the flowers.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here you go. Sometimes all you have to do is ask.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thank you... They're even more beautiful now that I own them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure you actually learned a lesson here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, you can't always get something something.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Close enough... For you.
Hamlet playfully nudges Sowphelia.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Good aim.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Thanks!
The arrow strikes Owen!
Owen is suddenly filled with the radiance of love. Struck, he turns his head, and his gaze lands on a tall vase of flowers at the front of the store!
He stares at them in wonder.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen? What are you looking at?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: These flowers. They're `perfect.`
nodes.text_bbcode: These flowers. They're [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... `Perfect...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're `color blind.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you're [color=#3b78e2][i]color blind.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I `have` to get these. I love them.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to get these. I love them.

nodes.text: Paige scowls as the cupigs look at one another.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What `is` wrong with him?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] wrong with him?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You know how the cupig's arrow instills great love in whosoever it pierces?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Well, in this case, it must've accidentally instilled a great love for the flowers Owen was looking at.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nothing's wrong with me! It's these `flowers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing's wrong with me! It's these [color=#e23b3b][i]flowers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're petunias!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Petunias'? What a great flower name! How much are they?

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: I'm so happy you enjoy that bouquet. It's seven dollars.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I only have five... But I'd be lost without them.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Well, you do seem to truly enjoy them... And it is Valentine's Day. I'll make them five for you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh thank you!
Owen pays, and Paige drags him and his bouquet out of the flower shop.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you crazy?
Owen tears his gaze away from the flowers to Paige's face. He squints, then shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait, what just happened?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You just haggled a vendor down for `petunias!` And with the last of our money!
nodes.text_bbcode: You just haggled a vendor down for [color=#3b78e2][i]petunias![/i][/color] And with the last of our money!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I kind of remember that... But these flowers were just so nice.
He hands them to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I must have gotten them for you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're not roses... But okay.
Behind them, Sowphelia gives Hamlet a sorrowful look.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: That went `terribly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That went [color=#3b78e2][i]terribly.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Hey, at last he got her flowers. Even if they're not the ones she wanted...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Owen!
Hamlet looses the arrow!
Half an hour later, Paige and Owen gather up their food and walk back into the downtown.
They pass by a flower stall, and Paige stops in front of a pail of pink roses.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really stopping to smell the roses?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, these are gorgeous. But I wouldn't expect you to recognize something with class.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And they smell amazing. How much are they?
The vendor tending the flowers looks up with a pleasant smile.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Fifteen for the bouquet...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You do remember that you don't have a credit card, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. Rub my face in it. How do you manage?
Owen checks his wallet and realizes he's on his last five dollars.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not much left...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But maybe this is a good lesson for you. Sometimes, you don't always get what you want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As a heart attack. It's a concept I'm sure you don't get at all... But it might make you a better person.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Sure.` Well, I may not be able to buy them, but I can still `shop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sure.[/i][/color] Well, I may not be able to buy them, but I can still [color=#3b78e2][i]shop![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige goes from bouquet to bouquet in the stall, admiring each bloom.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Hamlet, this is perfect! They're in a `flower` shop, the place where love `blossoms`... He can buy her flowers!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hamlet, this is perfect! They're in a [color=#3b78e2][i]flower[/i][/color] shop, the place where love [color=#3b78e2][i]blossoms[/i][/color]... He can buy her flowers!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: With five dollars?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We'll think of something...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I can steal a bouquet and drop it off somewhere...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The flower vendor might think they did it, and nothing's going to kill the mood faster than one of them getting in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What about a Cupig's Arrow?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We only have `two`...
nodes.text_bbcode: We only have [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: And their date is nearly over. We're running out of time!
Hamlet shrugs and closes his eyes. A gilded bow primed with a heart-tipped arrow appears in his hooves.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Who do I aim for?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Aim for...
Aided by Hamlet's wings, the rain clouds drift over Paige and Owen. A light drizzle starts to fall from the skies, stopping their conversation.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The food!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forget the food! What about my hair?! I `knew` I hated the outdoors!
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget the food! What about my hair?! I [color=#3b78e2][i]knew[/i][/color] I hated the outdoors!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's get out of here before it gets worse!
Owen bundles up their meal, grabs Paige's hand, and leads her into the cover of some close trees.
From underneath thick branches, they look out at the falling rain together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got the food. How's the hair?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It'll manage.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So you seriously don't think you're a snob? You just tried to save your `hair.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So you seriously don't think you're a snob? You just tried to save your [color=#e23b3b][i]hair.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige glares at him... Then suddenly, she laughs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, `fine.` So I'm not exactly low-maintenance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]fine.[/i][/color] So I'm not exactly low-maintenance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Say it. You're a snob.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha, no way!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Say it! 'I am a snob'!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I will say `this...` You're still holding my hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: I will say [color=#3b78e2][i]this...[/i][/color] You're still holding my hand!

nodes.text: Owen drops it and wipes his hand on his shirt.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Gross. I feel slimy and rich.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Looks like you know a thing or two about setting the mood, Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I've learned from the best, Sowphelia.
They grin at one another, as Paige and Owen sit down on a fallen tree to wait the rain out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, I know I flipped out, but maybe I just don't want to be seen like that, okay? That's how everyone at Monarch Prep is, and... I'll admit, it's going to be hard going back.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've gotten used to being at Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've even gotten used to you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There are no boys at Monarch Prep. And it's going to be boring if there's no one to make fun of.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm just your regular punching bag, am I?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. A punching bag puts up more of a fight.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, maybe it'd suck not having you around either. I mean, what am I going to do in Psych without you? Your life is so messed up.
Paige stares at him for a moment, as if trying to decide whether his sentence is funny or awful.
Then she starts laughing. And he joins in too.
When they quiet, they sit close to one another until the rain passes. From their vantage point in the trees, Sowphelia huddles happily next to Hamlet.
Aided by Hamlet's wings, the clouds part, clearing a swath of sunlight onto Paige and Owen's picnic.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's getting bright out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, and I suppose now you're going to make jokes about how I need a dainty little umbrella to shade myself.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I didn't mean like that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't get it. I make fun of you all the time. Why are you being so sensitive about it now?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, can't we just talk about something else?
They sit in silence as Owen fumbles for what to say.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... You and this, uh, Monarch Prep thing, huh? What's that all about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, could you begin a painful conversation `more` awkwardly?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, could you begin a painful conversation [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] awkwardly?

nodes.text: Paige glares at him, and he shrugs uncomfortably.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Monarch Prep is my mom's way of getting rid of me so she can travel and play tongue polo with Tad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ew, well, that image just killed my appetite.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Welcome to my life.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And there's no way you can get out of this?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course not. My mother's determined to get me out of her uptight French twist. I won't be able to back out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Besides, Monarch Prep's the better school. If I go there, I'm set. I have everything. My nice clothes, my private dorm, my spending accounts...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's probably good that I'm leaving.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't say that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What, are you going to miss me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, Psych `is` going to be a whole lot more boring without your messed up brain to analyze.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, Psych [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] going to be a whole lot more boring without your messed up brain to analyze.

nodes.text: Sowphelia sees that it's the wrong thing to say as Paige rolls her eyes and slows her chewing so she won't have to talk.
With the warm sunlight beating down on them, Paige and Owen spend the rest of their meal in silence. From their vantage point in the trees, Sowphelia huddles sulkily next to Hamlet.
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly low, following Owen and Paige to their picnic spot in the park.
He sets down the grocery bag and spreads his jacket out, putting it on the ground for Paige to sit on.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you sure you're the same Owen? The Owen I know isn't this gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't need to know what every fork is to have good manners.
He plops down next to her and opens the grocery bag. They eat hungrily while they enjoy the view of the park.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who needs five-star food when you've got groceries?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyone who has standards?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not all of us can be so snobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not snobby!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You live in a four-story mansion and eat on plates of gold. You can't tell me you're not a prissy snob.
Above them, Sowphelia shoots Hamlet a worried glance.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: They can't start fighting now... Not when they're in a beautiful park together!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's not fighting. They're just ribbing each other. It's like flirting.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure? Paige is a little `emotional`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure? Paige is a little [color=#3b78e2][i]emotional[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that really what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Do you have a problem with it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean... Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Usually, you love the fact that you're a mean rich girl who thinks she's better than anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just because that's what I `am` doesn't mean I `like` being called that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because that's what I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] doesn't mean I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] being called that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure I follow...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You just don't get it...
Hamlet looks at Sowphelia worriedly.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Is there something we can throw at him? Or her?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: The clouds!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We can use the weather. There are rainy clouds over there... Or I can push them back and make it sunny.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: A warm sunny day might put them in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I say, let it rain.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not `romantic` to get cold and wet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]romantic[/i][/color] to get cold and wet!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: But there are a lot of good rainy scenes in the humans' romantic comedies...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Hmm...
Hamlet and Sowphelia fly frantically around, checking each window... But Paige is nowhere to be found.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: This house is too big! We'll never find it now...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: You can't give up yet! I'm checking one more window...
Sowphelia peeks into one last window and spots Paige brushing her hair at her vanity table.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is the room! I see Paige!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Yes! Finally! But we gotta do something fast, Owen looks like that he's about to leave!
The next day...
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly to the window outside Paige's room. They can hear Paige and her mother arguing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was a `party,` not a `gala.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was a [color=#3b78e2][i]party,[/i][/color] not a [color=#3b78e2][i]gala.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: A party that would have ruined `my` home.
nodes.text_bbcode: A party that would have ruined [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] home.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: There were `hoodlums` jumping like cannon balls into the pool, and there were `strings of paper` hanging from my chandelier!
nodes.text_bbcode: There were [color=#3b78e2][i]hoodlums[/i][/color] jumping like cannon balls into the pool, and there were [color=#3b78e2][i]strings of paper[/i][/color] hanging from my chandelier!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's called `crepe paper`, and it's a `decoration.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's called [color=#3b78e2][i]crepe paper[/i][/color], and it's a [color=#3b78e2][i]decoration.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: That's even more atrocious than I'd previously imagined.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I bet Dad wouldn't have minded. He'd have thought it was funny.
Margot glares at her daughter and shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Don't talk about him. You have a new father in your life.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And until further notice, you're `grounded.` You are forbidden to leave the grounds.
nodes.text_bbcode: And until further notice, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]grounded.[/i][/color] You are forbidden to leave the grounds.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's what 'grounded' means, doesn't it?
As soon as Margot shuts the door firmly behind her, Paige flops angrily down onto her bed.
Outside Paige's window, Sowphelia gives Hamlet a worried look.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: If Paige is stuck at home, how are we ever going to get them together?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We'll think of something. Let's go find Owen. Can you track him?
Sowphelia sniffs the air, her snout twitching.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We don't have to! He's here!
Still invisible, they fly down from the `fifth window` on the `third floor` and find Owen at the front door. He's talking to Tad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Still invisible, they fly down from the [b]fifth window[/b] on the [b]third floor[/b] and find Owen at the front door. He's talking to Tad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Young ruffian, Paige is currently 'grounded' and unable to see visitors at this time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right... Is there a better time when I can come back?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Certainly not for `you.` Paige is a very important young lady. You are not of suitable rank to her social standing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Certainly not for [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] Paige is a very important young lady. You are not of suitable rank to her social standing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's up for Paige to decide. Now if you'd just move aside--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It would be most inappropriate for me to let you in. Now good day! And do not call again.
The door shuts in Owen's face before Owen can so much as get another word out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Not of suitable rank'? Well, it's going to take a lot more than that to keep me from seeing her...
Owen glances at the formidable doors in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I guess it'll just have to be next week at school...
He starts walking away from the manor. Sowphelia and Hamlet exchange glances.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Any ideas? Too bad we can't push one of these topiaries onto his head. Or talk to him directly.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: You know we can't reveal ourselves!
Sowphelia notices Owen's cell phone peeking out of his back pocket.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But we can send him a message...
Sowphelia flutters her wings, and a silver halo surrounds the phone. It begins to ring. Owen picks it up and glances at the caller.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige?
He answers, but there's no one on the other line.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe she's sending me a message...
He walks back towards the manor, ducking behind the house to find Paige's room. He looks up and sees four floors with five windows on each level.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't tell which room's hers... She just has to live in a house with twenty windows, doesn't she?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to show him which one's Paige's room.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Where is it again?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Her room is on...
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly down, shooting through the blanket of stars and clouds to earth below.
From the air, they can see the bright lights of a party at Paige's manor.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What could have gone wrong?! They were enjoying the party when we left!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Things change quickly. Come on, let's get into stealth mode before one of these young humans see us.
Sowphelia concentrates and flutters her wings. A shimmery halo rings her tiny body, then fades away.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Done. Let's fly in for a closer look.
Hamlet turns himself invisible and follows her.
The cupigs find their way inside...
Where Paige's mother Margot and soon-to-be stepfather Tad are standing in the foyer, yelling at Paige!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Never mind `that!` What is this, Paige?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color] What is this, Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not supposed to be back for another week!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `Surprise.` Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Surprise.[/i][/color] Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are my friends, mom.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Ha! Now I know you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: This is exactly what I've been telling you about, Margot. The rebelliousness comes from her peers.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You're right. So right. This abomination here is the reason, Paige, why we decided you will no longer be attending that public school!
The partygoers gasp!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It's why you'll be going `back` to Monarch Prep!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's why you'll be going [color=#3b78e2][i]back[/i][/color] to Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Now everyone else, get out of my house this instant, or I shall call the authorities!
Margot and Tad start marshaling everyone out of the house as Owen turns to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why didn't you tell me your mother was sending you back to Monarch?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why would I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... Maybe because we're friends? You didn't think this was something you could warn me about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe I didn't see why it would really `matter.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I didn't see why it would really [color=#3b78e2][i]matter.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I see...
Owen turns away from her and starts walking away.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm leaving. Your mom is kicking everyone out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I don't see why that would `matter` to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't see why that would [color=#e23b3b][i]matter[/i][/color] to you.

nodes.text: As Owen walks away, Sowphelia hisses to Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: He's leaving! And they're never going to kiss tomorrow if we don't do something!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What do you suggest I do? Tackle him?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: That's not a `bad` idea...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not a [color=#3b78e2][i]bad[/i][/color] idea...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You know we can't touch them directly. We can only move things around them...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you going to quote the entire Cupig's Hoofbook to me? Do something!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Do you have any suggestions?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What about using a Cupig's Arrow? We could make Owen change his mind!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We only have one each... We can't use them every time we run into a problem.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Good point. Okay, uh...
She has failed.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: No, that's not right...
She tries to correct, but instead, flubs the shot! The arrow embeds itself in the green grass next to the road.
Pink flowers burst into life where the arrow hits, blooming rapidly then bursting into a flurry of pink petals before vanishing.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: No! The last arrow!
She looks mournfully from her bow to the car speeding off into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: There's no hope now... Margot'll find out Paige isn't home. She'll get in trouble. And she and Owen will never be together...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You don't know that... There's still `some` time.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't know that... There's still [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] time.

nodes.text: Sowphelia nods her head, but in her heart, she knows...
Sowphelia and Hamlet veer away from Paige to fly after Margot and Tad's car.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We have to make it break down somehow! But it's going too fast!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to go faster!
Sowphelia grits her pig teeth and...
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly low, following Owen and Paige to their picnic spot in the park.
He sets down the grocery bag and spreads his jacket out, putting it on the ground for Paige to sit on.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you sure you're the same Owen? The Owen I know isn't this gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't need to know what every fork is to have good manners.
He plops down next to her and opens the grocery bag. They eat hungrily while they enjoy the view of the park.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who needs five-star food when you've got groceries?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyone who has standards?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not all of us can be so snobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not snobby!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You live in a four-story mansion and eat on plates of gold. You can't tell me you're not a prissy snob.
Above them, Sowphelia shoots Hamlet a worried glance.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: They can't start fighting now... Not when they're in a beautiful park together!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's not fighting. They're just ribbing each other. It's like flirting.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure? Paige is a little `emotional`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure? Paige is a little [color=#3b78e2][i]emotional[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that really what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Do you have a problem with it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean... Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Usually, you love the fact that you're a mean rich girl who thinks she's better than anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just because that's what I `am` doesn't mean I `like` being called that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because that's what I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] doesn't mean I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] being called that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure I follow...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You just don't get it...
Hamlet looks at Sowphelia worriedly.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Is there something we can throw at him? Or her?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: The clouds!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We can use the weather. There are rainy clouds over there... Or I can push them back and make it sunny.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: A warm sunny day might put them in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I say, let it rain.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not `romantic` to get cold and wet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]romantic[/i][/color] to get cold and wet!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: But there are a lot of good rainy scenes in the humans' romantic comedies...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Hmm...

nodes.text: This is it! The third floor, fifth window!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The third floor, first window!
They fly up to it and find one of the maids calmly stuffing some of the silver as she clears away the remains of a lavish breakfast buffet.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We got the wrong window!
He starts to fly away, but stops when Sowphelia doesn't move.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The maid's stealing the silver! Should we do something?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's not our job. Our job is getting Paige and Owen to kiss!
This Valentine's Day, we're doing things a little differently!

Sowphelia and her `cupig` partner, Hamlet, talk over a trough at their local hangout, The Pig Pen.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sowphelia and her [b]cupig[/b] partner, Hamlet, talk over a trough at their local hangout, The Pig Pen.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I don't know how you're so calm. Things are not looking good, Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I'm talking about the assignment that the great and glorious Hogfather gave us. Tomorrow is Valentine's Day, and Paige and Owen aren't together yet!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Their love is written in the stars! I hope I don't have to remind you what the Hogfather will do if we miss the Valentine's Day deadline. He will `not` be pleased.
nodes.text_bbcode: Their love is written in the stars! I hope I don't have to remind you what the Hogfather will do if we miss the Valentine's Day deadline. He will [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] be pleased.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Don't get your pigtail in a curl, Sowphelia. They're right on schedule. We'll barely even have to lift a hoof to get them together. I swear a week's truffles on it.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I... I don't know. I used to think that way, ever since Owen and Paige connected during the their psychology project...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But they've had so many chances since then, and they still haven't committed to each other.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Eh, I don't know why you care so much. It's not like they're soulmates or anything.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: `Yes`, they are. Paige and Owen forever!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes[/i][/color], they are. Paige and Owen forever!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: 'Paige and Owen'? They don't even have a cool name to 'ship' them by. What are you going to call them? 'Powen'?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Yeah! What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's just that they've got nothing on $ZOE and Owen. Maybe the Hogfather got this one wrong.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The Hogfather is never wrong! Besides $ZOE always gets her way. She just got Social Chair. Why should she get Owen too?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Because Paige is super mean. Why should she and Owen be together?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Because...
